title: Contextual Memory-Enhanced Source Coding for Low-SNR Communications
abstract: arXiv:2605.04400v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Separate Source-Channel Coding (SSCC) remains vulnerable in noisy text transmission due to the fragility of autoregressive source decoding, especially when Arithmetic Coding (AC) relies on Large Language Model (LLM)-based probability estimation. This letter proposes a Memory-Augmented Source Coding (MASC) scheme that internalizes contextual patterns into a source model. Specifically, MASC employs a shared Parameterized Contextual Memory (PCM) for multi-order $n$-gram patterns, and a Mixture-of-Memory-Experts Router (MMER) for sparse, hidden-state-dependent routing over memory experts. This adaptive activation refines source probability estimation, shortens codelength, and mitigates decoding sensitivity to residual channel errors. Experiments over Rayleigh fading and AWGN channels demonstrate its effectiveness.

translated_title: 低信噪比通信中的上下文记忆增强源编码
translated_abstract: 摘要：在噪声文本传输中，分离源信道编码（SSCC）由于自回归源解码的脆弱性而仍然易受影响，特别是当算术编码（AC）依赖于基于大型语言模型（LLM）的概率估计时。本文提出了一种记忆增强源编码（MASC）方案，该方案将上下文模式内化到源模型中。具体而言，MASC采用共享的参数化上下文记忆（PCM）来处理多阶$n$-gram模式，并使用混合记忆专家路由器（MMER）对记忆专家进行稀疏的、依赖于隐藏状态的路径选择。这种自适应激活机制细化了源概率估计，缩短了码长，并减轻了解码对残余信道误差的敏感性。在瑞利衰落和加性高斯白噪声信道上的实验证明了其有效性。
tldr: 提出一种记忆增强源编码方案，通过共享参数化上下文记忆和混合记忆专家路由器，在低信噪比通信中改善源概率估计、缩短码长并增强对信道误差的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: A memory-augmented source coding scheme is proposed, leveraging shared parameterized contextual memory and a mixture-of-memory-experts router to improve source probability estimation, shorten codelength, and enhance robustness against channel errors in low-SNR communications.
